_note: Terms as used by the Telugu IRV (tel2017) so narration and quoted verses use the same vocabulary. Counts are occurrences in the tel2017 corpus (checked with bible.py). Translators may deviate for natural phrasing, but names of God and key theological terms should stay consistent with the chosen Bible version.
register: Respectful, warm devotional Telugu. Address the audience with మీరు (plural/respectful) forms; refer to God with ఆయన. Avoid English loanwords where a natural Telugu word exists.
